label: monero v0.18.5.1 construct_tx: 2-in 2-out, generated tx keys

construct.note: One recipient plus change, carrying monero's dummy encrypted payment id. The transaction key is generated, and it is the first random_scalar of the stream; two inputs make one pseudo output mask random as well, so the stream has to line up from the very first draw. test/tx-monero.js rebuilds it byte-for-byte, proofs included, from the fields here on the mocked random stream.
